text: bhikkhuno avijjā pahiyyati vijjā uppajjatīti . idha bhikkhu bhikkhuno sutaṃ hoti sabbe dhammā nālaṃ abhinivesāyāti . evañcetaṃ bhikkhu bhikkhuno sutaṃ hoti sabbe dhammā nālaṃ abhinivesāyāti . so sabbaṃ dhammaṃ abhijānāti sabbaṃ dhammaṃ abhiññāya sabbaṃ dhammaṃ parijānāti sabbaṃ dhammaṃ pariññāya sabbanimittāni aññato passati cakkhuṃ aññato #1 yu. uppajjatīti . passati rūpe cakkhuviññāṇaṃ cakkhusamphassaṃ yampidaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi aññato passati .pe. manaṃ aññato passati dhamme manoviññāṇaṃ manosamphassaṃ yampidaṃ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ
